title: How some ZIA Terraform data sources look things up

prose.text: Data sources look up one object by name or ID, but a few have lookup modes of their own. The ones below changed recently or return something other than a single match.

prose.label: Firewall filtering rules.
prose.text: {{fw-rule-collection-mode}} Whether list-all reads are bounded on large tenants is open {{gap:fw-rule-list-all-limits}}.

prose.label: Cloud App Control actions.
prose.text: {{cac-actions-split}} The action rules themselves are in [[zia.cloud-app-control.actions]]. Other lookup defects, such as selectors that are never read, are in [[zia.terraform.data-source-fidelity]].

fw-rule-collection-mode.statement: Since provider v4.7.21 the `zia_firewall_filtering_rule` data source returns a list of rules in a `rules` block when no single-rule lookup is supplied; the numeric lookup argument is `rule_id` (previously `id`), the name lookup is `name`, and the optional `search` is a client-side JMESPath filter applied after the server-side filters.

quotes: Enhanced the `zia_firewall_filtering_rule` data source to return a list of rules via the new `rules` block when no single-rule lookup is supplied
use `rule_id` for the numeric lookup (previously `id`) or `name` for the name lookup
JMESPath runs **after** the server-side filters, against the raw API JSON.
* `search` - (Optional, String) [JMESPath](https://jmespath.org/) expression applied to the results after the server-side filters above.

ips-categories-lookup.statement: The `zia_ips_categories` data source resolves a category by `id`, else by case-insensitive `name`, and with neither returns every category; the returned name is the exact identifier the firewall rules' `res_categories` and `dest_ip_categories` expect.

cac-actions-split.statement: The Cloud App Control actions data source returns the available actions both together and split into `available_actions_without_isolate` and `isolate_actions`; the provider documents that ISOLATE actions need a Cloud Browser Isolation subscription and must be used alone in a rule.

fw-rule-list-all-limits.title: Whether list-all retrieval on rule data sources is limited by endpoint pagination
fw-rule-list-all-limits.detail: Unverified legacy statement: provider maintainers called out endpoint pagination limits in the upstream discussion of list-all retrieval, and the same list-all behavior should not be assumed for every rule data source. The vendored sources document the firewall data source's collection mode but say nothing about pagination limits or about which other rule data sources support it.
fw-rule-list-all-limits.blocks: saying whether a list-all read of a rule data source returns every rule on a large tenant
